artworks.title: Venus and Adonis
artworks.description: Titian's warning and farewell — Venus clinging to the youth who will not heed the boar, the anemone still to rise from his blood in Ovid's telling.

artworks.title: The Birth of Adonis
artworks.description: Monsiau's Myrrha-tree — Adonis born from the bark that hid his mother's crime, Ovid's Cypriot metamorphosis made visible.

artworks.title: The Death of Adonis
artworks.description: Rubens' Israel Museum canvas — the boar's wound and Venus' grief, the end of Myrrha's son who would not stay.

artworks.title: Venus and Adonis
artworks.description: Veronese's Venetian idyll — Venus watching over the sleeping hunter before the hunt that ends the lineage of Myrrha.

artworks.title: Myrrha and Cinyras
artworks.description: Zanchi's Baroque crime — the incest that begets Adonis and drives Myrrha into the myrrh-tree.
